en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a construction or excavation site in front of a series of ruined masonry arches or vaults. Several workers in early 20th‑century clothing are engaged in digging and handling wooden forms and planks. Behind the ruins there is a low building with a gabled roof and a chimney, and a line of trees forming the background. The overall look is documentary rather than touristic, and there is no visible caption on the image.
